name: Delivery
why: A change, from the approved plan to merged on the default branch
ideal: Small changes, planned first, green on first push, reviewed at the head and merged within a day, judged by lead time and failure, not volume.

sources.title: Google engineering practices: speed of code reviews
Trunk Based Development: short-lived feature branches

steps.name: Plan
steps.rule: Plan in an issue before code, and split the work into changes that each land on their own.

steps.name: Build
steps.rule: Build in small changes, each pull request short enough to review in one sitting.

steps.name: Check
tools: GitHub Actions standard runners, ubuntu-slim for light jobs
Included Actions usage, a budget that stops at it
Free lanes: public repos, third-party free minutes
steps.rule: CI checks every pull request on the cheapest runner that fits, green on first push, within included minutes.

steps.name: Review
steps.rule: A reviewer runs the checks on the head commit within a day; a fix needs a new review.

steps.name: Merge
steps.rule: Merge the reviewed head SHA within minutes of every check going green.
